text:
We can confirm that Northwind Regional is opening a new hub at Castellane Airfield, with initial operations scheduled for 14 April. The airline says the base will support six daily regional rotations in its first month, rising to ten by midsummer as additional crews are positioned on site. We have reviewed the field plan and note that work is already under way on a dedicated turnaround stand, a small maintenance bay, and crew reporting rooms in the east apron module. Northwind has also signed a three-year ground-services agreement with Valeport Handling.

Key facts:
- Hub launch: 14 April
- Initial aircraft: 4 turboprops
- First-month schedule: 6 daily rotations
- Midyear target: 10 daily rotations
- Ground services partner: Valeport Handling
